findings.evidence: Runner compares four unchanged selected arms per six default frozen cases, checking status, selected start, selected w/x/root/diagnostic exactly. findings.evidence: readouts.py requests m.rc_envelope only for names starting TaylorRC_. CayleyRC_TaylorH2 receives no P2_RC_envelope. H6 applies only to unchanged TaylorH2 H representation.
